results.title: Develocity Predictive Test Selection | Stop running unnecessary tests | Gradle Technologies
results.snippet: Choose between three selection profiles—Conservative, Standard, and Fast—to set up the right balance between time savings and prediction accuracy. You can choose to run all remaining tests in a later development stage on CI to ensure all tests are ultimately executed while still avoiding redundant test executions.

results.title: Predictive Test Selection | Develocity Documentation 2026.2
results.snippet: Predictive Test Selection uses a machine learning model to identify which tests are relevant to a code change and runs only those tests. You trade full test coverage for faster feedback: local and pre-merge builds complete faster, while a subsequent pipeline stage can run the remaining tests.

results.title: Develocity Predictive Test Selection Guide | Develocity Documentation 2026.2
results.snippet: Before executing a test suite, builds with Predictive Test Selection enabled ask Develocity to predict which of the tests-to-be-executed will provide useful feedback on the changes under test, selecting only those tests for execution. The Build Scan® indicates which tests were selected and which weren’t along with the reason why.
